Noise and double-texting, unchanged and still how this fails.

Three numbers on one proposal all look correct and only invoice.total is what the customer was quoted; the discount label itself is off by three points on at least one live proposal. Any change that sums, subtracts or applies a percentage reintroduces an $825 error. Our own marketing arrives labelled inbound and byte-identical to what we sent. iPhone tapbacks arrive as inbound and are our own words quoted back. Inbound email arrives with no body at all. A similarity score cannot gate a draft. 'Customer wants to rent a car' — never offered, never answered — scores 75% on the reranker, one point below a genuine reschedule. Whether the retrieved exemplar is the same KIND of message is checkable; how similar it is, is not.
